glosses: a grace, an act of mercy or graciousness; something good that one cannot control or does not deserve

examples.text: Leute, die Kindern wehtun, verdienen keine Gnade.
examples.en: People who hurt children do not deserve mercy.

examples.text: Tom ersuchte den Richter um Gnade.
examples.en: Tom appealed to the judge for mercy.

examples.text: Der Verteidiger ersuchte um Gnade für den Verurteilten.
examples.en: The defense attorney asked for mercy for the condemned man.
